description:
The outbound transfer arc in the /fly 3D scene (and possibly the /explore mission overlay) has the wrong curvature for some missions — the endpoints coincide with the correct planet positions but the arc between them deviates from the expected Keplerian half-ellipse shape.

Expected: Every outbound transfer arc in the app must be a proper Keplerian conic section (a portion of an ellipse with the Sun at one focus). For the /fly screen, the arc must be the true Keplerian ellipse through the two live planet positions (Earth at departure, destination at flyby/arrival). For the /explore mission overlay, the arc must be a Keplerian half-ellipse (ν: 0→π) starting at Earth's departure position.

Acceptance criteria:
- Every outbound arc point must be finite (no NaN, no ±Infinity). [code-invariant: self-evident: the app must not produce non-finite coordinates]
- The outbound arc's first point must be within 0.15 AU of Earth's heliocentric position at dep_day (for V∞-shaped missions) or exactly at Earth's position (for baseline Hohmann). [repo-data: src/lib/trajectory-soundness.test.ts:193-195]
- The outbound arc's last point must be within 0.25 AU of the destination's heliocentric position at flyby_day / arr_day. [repo-data: src/lib/trajectory-soundness.test.ts:216-217]
- The outbound arc must be a Keplerian ellipse arc (or half-ellipse) — not a Bezier curve, cosine profile, or other non-conic interpolation. The midpoint radius must satisfy the conic equation r = a(1−e²)/(1+e·cos(ν)) for the swept true anomaly. [spec: CLAUDE.md ADR-010: 'Transfer arc: Keplerian half-ellipses']
- The return arc (free-return / round-trip) must be a Keplerian ellipse arc, not a cosine-interpolated radius approximation. [spec: CLAUDE.md ADR-010: 'Transfer arc: Keplerian half-ellipses' — no exception for the return leg]
